Name: Ellie's Three Cats
Author: EllieBellaLuna
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Ellie's Three Cats
[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11284/11284-1648436223-742862734.gif[/img]﻿

This mod replaces the three cats in the game with my three cats: Apollo, Godzilla, and Kevin.

You can specify which cat replaces which cat option or set a cat replacement to "false" to disable the replacement.

[b]NEW: I added "Spirit Guide" as an option after they appeared to me in a dream. It's a grey cat with three orange eyes.[/b][/center]
